caption: The drawing depicts a round food cover (possibly a butter dish cover) with a matching round plate underneath it. Both the cover and plate have a textured surface composed of circular, bubble-like patterns. The dominant colors are shades of red, pink, and yellow, with some brownish undertones. The food cover has a knob on top colored in yellow and brown tones, giving the appearance of a glass or ceramic material. The plate shares the same bubble pattern and color scheme as the cover. To the right, there is a smaller side-view sketch of the same objects, showing the same round plate and dome with the knob, colored in a gradient from red at the top of the dome to yellow at the bottom. There is also a faint handwritten note below the side-view sketch. The objects are set against a plain, light beige background with no additional elements.
title: Butter Dish (Ameberina)
